name: News-sentiment dive velocity as fresh-panic trigger on 1d (long)
rationale: MECHANISM: velocity variant using news_sentiment crossing DOWN through a fitted level — a sharp DIVE in the news-mood series marks a fresh negative catalyst hitting, where the emotional overshoot is largest, versus a chronically-negative news backdrop that is already priced. We confirm with a same-window price drop (ret_Nd) and require realized vol elevated so we act inside genuine forced flow. Long the reversion of the overshoot; exit when news mood recovers or stop/TP/time. Distinct from the fear_greed and cryptopanic velocity specs: news_sentiment sources from headline flow, a different information channel, so it tests whether the panic-velocity edge is channel-robust. DISCONFIRMER: jointly regress forward return on news LEVEL vs the cross event; if level dominates, this duplicates a level fade — kill. If the news-dive works identically on random bars, it is short-horizon mean-reversion — kill.
catalyst: a sharp dive in news sentiment into a volatile price drop
